name: Pesto Ground Beef and Zucchini Skillet

fit.reason: 414 cal (400-650 OK) and 5.8g carbs (<=35 OK); ground-beef skillet, no seafood, weigh-and-divide scalable to 14.

dupe_check.evidence: Nearest catalog dish (cheesy-zucchini-beef-rice-skillet) shares only protein+skillet+zucchini; it is a rice-based diced-tomato/cheddar Tex-Mex plate, whereas this is a starchless pesto/sun-dried-tomato/goat-cheese Mediterranean skillet -- 2-of-4 core factors, distinct dinner. No other catalog beef recipe pairs pesto with zucchini.

cross_protein_watch: Structurally a 'pesto + zucchini + ground meat skillet' -- a ground-turkey or ground-chicken pesto-zucchini skillet in another selector's pool would be the same dish with a swapped protein; decider should merge-check turkey/chicken pools.
Catalog turkey-pesto-pasta-kale shares the pesto note only (pasta-based, kale, no zucchini) -- not a collision.
note: Unmapped goat-cheese retained deliberately (v2.1 5.1 pricer-lane exercise), not a demerit.
